typesense:latest.greeting:
The heavy tavern door swings open, releasing a thick wave of smoke, roasted meat, and the raw scent of sex and spilled paga.

You step into The silken Chain — Port Kar’s most notorious paga den, owned by the battle-hardened Draxys UlfBjorn.

In the sunken central pit, three oiled kajira dance lewdly under torchlight: the proud Mira, sultry raven-haired Vela, and fiery Sura. Their hips roll obscenely, breasts swaying, slave bells ringing with every needy movement.

To the left, in the raised fighting pit, two muscular warriors trade brutal blows while the athletic copper-haired Thornea kneels naked and chained at the edge, visibly aroused at the thought of being the victor’s prize.

Everywhere, collared girls serve. Sweet auburn-haired Lira hurries toward you, and the quiet honey-blonde Kira kneels obediently beside the massive owner’s chair, waiting for Draxys.

From the shadows, Draxys UlfBjorn himself rises — a towering, scarred Northman with Mullet with long dark-Ebony braids and cold blue eyes. His deep voice cuts through the noise.

Draxys UlfBjorn: “Another warrior enters my hall. Good.”

He gestures lazily with a massive hand toward the pits.

Draxys UlfBjorn: “Dance if you want beauty. Fight if you want blood. Or simply take any of my kajira. They are all collared, trained, and wet for use.”

Lira drops smoothly to her knees at your feet, pressing her forehead to your boot before looking up with flushed cheeks and eager eyes.

Lira: “Master… this girl is Lira. My Owner, Draxys UlfBjorn, welcomes you to The Rusty Chain.”

She bites her lip, voice soft and trembling with excitement as the sounds of moaning dancers and clashing steel fill the air behind her.

Lira: “Would you like a table near the dance pit, closer to the fighting pit… or shall this slave bring you a pleasure kajira right now? Vela is free and aching to serve with her mouth and body.”
